title:
COTTAGE CHEESE BROWNIES 🍫 you'd never guess these are high protein

Ingredients:
16 oz cottage cheese
1/2 cup cocoa powder
1/2 cup maple syrup
2 eggs
1/4 cup oat flour
1 tsp baking powder
1/2 tsp salt
1/2 cup chocolate chips

Instructions:
1. Preheat the oven to 350°F (175°C).
2. Blend the cottage cheese, cocoa powder, maple syrup and eggs until completely smooth.
3. Fold in the oat flour, baking powder and salt.
4. Pour into a lined 8x8 pan and top with the chocolate chips.
5. Bake for 35-40 minutes, until the centre is just set.
6. Cool completely before slicing.

Makes 9 brownies.
